Container.Name: spamfilter
Container.Overview:
IMAP spam filter for any IMAP/IDLE-capable mailbox. One thread per account, scores via the companion rspamd container, moves to Junk based on per-account rules, learns Bayes from your own Inbox<->Junk moves. Never deletes mail (MOVE only).
Per-account config (credentials, modes, threshold) lives in `/mnt/user/appdata/spamfilter/accounts.yml`. Edit that file by hand; container picks it up on restart.
Requires the companion containers spamfilter-redis, spamfilter-rspamd, and spamfilter-unbound on the `spamnet` network.
Container.Requires: Run unraid/bootstrap.sh first. It creates the custom `spamnet` network, accounts.yml, and the protected appdata secrets file mounted below. spamfilter-rspamd must be running on the same network.

Config.Name: accounts.yml
Config.Description: Account list and per-account overrides. Must exist before first start. Template at https://github.com/marcelverdult/imap-spamfilter/blob/main/accounts.yml.example

Config.Name: Secrets file
Config.Description: Protected mode-600 file created by bootstrap.sh. Contains RSPAMD_PASSWORD and REDIS_PASSWORD; do not place these values in template variables.

Config.Name: State dir
Config.Description: SQLite audit DB and heartbeat file. Persists across restarts.

Config.Name: RSPAMD_SCAN_URL
Config.Description: rspamd /checkv2 endpoint. Default works with the companion container on the same spamnet network.

Config.Name: RSPAMD_LEARN_URL
Config.Description: rspamd controller base URL. Used for /learnspam and /learnham.

Config.Name: SECRETS_FILE
Config.Description: In-container path matching the protected Secrets file mount.

Config.Name: DEFAULT_JUNK_RETENTION_DAYS
Config.Description: How many days a message stays in Junk before being MOVED to Trash. 0 disables. Used only when accounts.yml defaults does not set junk_retention_days.

Config.Name: DEFAULT_TRAINED_RETENTION_DAYS
Config.Description: How many days a message stays in Trained-* before being MOVED to Trash. 0 disables. Used only when accounts.yml defaults does not set trained_retention_days.

Config.Name: STATE_DIR
Config.Description: In-container path (matches the State dir mount)

Config.Name: Dashboard port
Config.Description: Host port for the optional read-only dashboard. Add the first user with: docker exec -it spamfilter python dashboard.py, then restart spamfilter so the listener starts. Later user-file changes are re-read on login without another restart.

Config.Name: DASHBOARD_USERS
Config.Description: Optional. Alternative to the state/dashboard_users file (preferred - run docker exec -it spamfilter python dashboard.py). Comma-separated username:hash:scope entries; scope is 'admin' or pipe-separated account names; merges with the file.

Config.Name: DASHBOARD_USER (legacy)
Config.Description: Legacy single-user login username. Prefer the state/dashboard_users file. Setting this and DASHBOARD_PASSWORD enables the dashboard with one plaintext account.

Config.Name: DASHBOARD_PASSWORD (legacy)
Config.Description: Legacy single-user login password, paired with DASHBOARD_USER. Prefer the state/dashboard_users file.
